description: This file implements guarded fetch logic with support for different modes, proxy handling, redirect management, and security checks, primarily for server-side rendering or secure network requests.

methods.name: withStrictGuardedFetchMode
methods.description: Returns fetch options with mode set to 'strict'.

methods.name: withTrustedEnvProxyGuardedFetchMode
methods.description: Returns fetch options with mode set to 'trusted_env_proxy'.

methods.name: resolveGuardedFetchMode
methods.description: Determines the fetch mode based on options, proxy settings, and flags.

methods.name: assertExplicitProxySupportsPinnedDns
methods.description: Checks if explicit proxy URL supports pinned DNS based on URL protocol.

methods.name: assertExplicitProxyAllowed
methods.description: Validates if the explicit proxy URL is valid and allowed based on hostname and policy.

methods.name: isRedirectStatus
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP status code indicates a redirect.

methods.name: retainSafeHeadersForCrossOriginRedirectHeaders
methods.description: Retains safe headers during cross-origin redirects.

methods.name: retainSafeHeadersForCrossOriginRedirect
methods.description: Prepares request init headers for cross-origin redirect by retaining safe headers.

methods.name: dropBodyHeaders
methods.description: Removes headers related to body content from headers.

methods.name: rewriteRedirectInitForMethod
methods.description: Adjusts request init for redirect responses, especially for POST to GET conversions.

methods.name: fetchWithSsrFGuard
methods.description: Main function performing guarded fetch with redirect handling, proxy support, and security checks.
